beats.say: Sea otters hold hands while sleeping to stay together.
Strong currents could otherwise sweep them apart.
Adults weigh between 14 and 45 kg, as heavy as a large dog.
Their fur is the densest in the animal kingdom.
This helps them stay warm in cold waters.
They can reach speeds of up to 9 kilometres per hour.
Holding hands shows their clever ways to survive.
Nature's simple solutions can be surprisingly effective. Have you seen otters?
